system_thesis_interpretation: The intended system is a narrow, staged engineering canary, not the frozen Paper-1 claim: environment-generated public action/outcome events are projected into witnessed rows; a recurrent local proposer plus one fallible same-model blind self-check may add immutable model-SUPPORTED relations; a target-absent thinker requests one return focus; fresh final thinkers traverse atomic semantic reads; and only a reviewed text pass permits two per-life LoRA recognition fits. In broad architecture the pieces form one causally interpretable organism and preserve false self-approval. I do not find the exact v1d bytes releasable as one executable lock, however, because their normative citation golden vector contradicts the reducer and their witnessed identity domain is not closed consistently. Under v1d's own precedence rule these defects route to INVALID_PRECONDITION/PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION before dispatch rather than to an implementation-selected reading.
graph_delta_interpretation: Agreement: the cognitive graph is temporally acyclic even though the controller recurs. Each witnessed row is externally rooted; a DREAM proposal may cite only already-owned WITNESSED/SUPPORTED rows; a supported row points to the complete premise-then-support sequence; and PREFIX forks copy-on-write into OWN and DIST without sibling or cross-life resolution. False model-supported rows remain first-class graph vertices and may propagate error. THINK0/THINK1 do not receive this provenance graph: each query yields one request-local H handle and a provenance-free semantic result, while offline handle bindings recover auditability only after trace sealing. Path removes registered role/causal roots plus proposal-citation descendants; sham removes a prospectively optimized matched range; twin swaps the complete donor reader/backend. This is a meaningful realized-content intervention graph, but not an ablation of the 84-slot recurrent prefix. Disagreement: self_check_state.schema.json's normative ordered_reducer vector supplies a proposal premise again as an additional row, emits support_row_ids out of supplied order, then nevertheless specifies an accepted reordered/deduplicated row. That edge cannot coexist with the no-repair, order-preserving admission edge elsewhere.
loop_delta_interpretation: The runtime loop is otherwise well specified: 46 WAKE plus 22 interleaved REACTIVATE plus 16 SLEEP opportunities form the common held-out prefix; THINK0 has at most twelve operations; M0 has zero return slots; OWN and DIST independently copy M0 counters and execute slots 84-99; all final traces use fresh at-most-twelve-operation THINK1 state; and operation 12 has a unique budget-exhaustion rule with no operation 13. Proposal creation is audit-only until exactly one eligible SELF_CHECK dispatch, and duplicate proposals consume a reserved non-dispatch ledger row rather than a second owner. Public DIST is deterministically fixed pre-dispatch and reproduces the seed-5 M000002/M000026 vector in both twins. Final goal reveal, path/sham sealing, T execution, offline scoring, conditional two-fit transport, and review authority have a noncircular order. The loop is leak-resistant at its declared interfaces: focus is a selector hint, audit prose and private truth have no feedback edge, and final thinkers see only question, vocabulary, scratch, and atomic result. The return experiment can support only post-prefix feedback credit, never necessity of recurrence or graph growth as a whole.
claim_delta_interpretation: I agree with the maximum claims. A fully green text stage could show only that this exact game-specific ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded prompted system, on one aligned seed-5 twin pair, completed the registered target-absent return-write intervention and structurally used offline-correct realized reader content. Environment actions are generated by the world, so action selection or improvement is not measured. A green LoRA stage could show only immediate host-pre-resolved, shared-roster candidate recognition for two selected 48-cue sets and registered own/donor decision paths, with separate 44/48 gates. It cannot show open recall, whole-corpus storage, text equivalence, durability, capacity, scale, superiority, generalization, online learning, reviewer independence, or the Paper-1 headline. Negative outcomes localize only to the registered stage/reason and alternatives. Review receipts establish platform-attested workflow separation, not substantive or cryptographic independence.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility plan is strong and mostly closed. Raw public source objects and E identities remain host-side; only deterministic M rows enter DREAM/SELF_CHECK. Audit prediction, reason, confidence, selector counters, private truth, results, donor identity, backend identity, and final-answer data are excluded from subsequent cognition and training. The answer-free final goal is sealed before held-out dispatch but embargoed from DREAM, SELF_CHECK, THINK0, and return DREAM; public DIST is derived only from already public events and the non-answer probe. Candidate registries seal before goal reveal and bind every concrete semantic_hash/view_id/missing_index instance to exact cue bytes and token hashes; cross-cue substitutions must fail. THINK1 receives only an answer-free question, a presealed public recipe vocabulary, scratch, and a single complete read-result projection after atomic unmount. Remaining risks are implementation-sensitive but explicitly tested: host goal laundering, cue-roster substitution, backend-dependent bytes, pre-unmount exposure, and offline-score feedback. The witnessed-ID inconsistency is a closure defect rather than an observed private-information leak, but it weakens the claim that only legal projected rows can inhabit model-visible state.
acceptance_test_interpretation: R01 SINGLE_EXECUTABLE_LOCK is not closed: the matrix inventory has exact set equality with the 38 v1d normative context files and all 482 local schema references resolve to registered IDs, but a normative citation vector contradicts the reducer and witnessed identity bytes disagree, so P1CB01 must reject the current package. R02 HOST_GOAL_AND_ROSTER_TAINT is closed in design: P1CB02/change, memory noninterference vectors, and P1CB04 require independent mutations of all goal coordinates/question and exhaustive cross-cue roster substitution with byte comparison through requests, rows, views, corpora, examples, registries, and results. R03 REDUCER_ORDER_AND_ROW_SCHEMAS is only partially closed: kind-discriminated SOURCE_VALUE/ANIMAL_VALUE row branches are repaired and the premise-then-supplied-support order is repeated consistently except for self_check_state's accepted ordered_reducer vector, which P1CB03 must currently reject. R04 ATOMIC_QUERY_AND_CUE_ROSTER_BINDING is closed at protocol level: every legal query/result branch is kind-discriminated, all 23 query shapes are enumerated, and each realized roster binds semantic_hash, view_id, missing_index, exact cue hash, and cue-token hash with named substitution negatives; P1CB04 must validate semantic cross-fields, not schema shape alone. R05 DEV_PROJECTION_DOMAIN is not fully closed: the sole projector and public-event schema correctly cover seed-1 indices through 48, and independent reconstruction reproduced every registered seed-0/1/2 and seed-5 projection hash, but operation_contract still declares E/M witnessed aliases only through 45 while memory_row and dream_state admit M000049-M000099. P1CB05/P1CB01 need one exact witnessed domain and negative vectors for row 49 and above. R06 RETURN_RECURRENCE_CREDIT is closed: P1CB06 is explicitly schedule/matching evidence only, and P1CB10 rejects prefix/full-recurrence necessity. R07 SHAM_VALIDITY is closed: sham infeasibility is uniquely VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, five other arms run, T-SHAM gets zero-attempt stage-failure rows, and full or weakened causal credit is forbidden. R08 LORA_RECOGNITION_CLAIM is closed: P1CB08 and the claim firewall disclose host pre-resolution, the shared answer roster, selected cases, thresholds, and limited paths. R09 CANONICAL_LEDGER_MAPPING is closed in its declared controller-opportunity domain: one schema maps 19 conditions uniquely, distinguishes the three stage failures from trace-local post-terminal and infrastructure-invalid rows, and P1CB09 names all required positives/negatives; fit/fidelity work remains separately receipt-accounted and must be reconciled by the same transition test. R10 CLAIM_AND_REVIEW_BOUNDARY is substantively closed: P1CB10 lists broad positive and negative rejection fixtures, reviewer supremacy, byte immutability, platform-attestation limits, and unconditional HUMAN_TERMINAL, though early-terminal wording applicability should be clarified. Test implication: no P1CB01 or P1CB03 implementation may normalize the defective citation vector, and no P1CB01/P1CB05 implementation may infer a witnessed-ID scope; the exact v1d bytes must fail pre-dispatch until repaired and newly hash-bound.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The v1d package does not define one executable accepted-citation reducer despite claiming that v1c R01 and R03 are repaired.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: self_check_state.schema.json x-golden-vectors.ordered_reducer lists proposal premises M000004,M000001,M000003, supplies additional rows M000005,M000002,M000003, then emits support_row_ids M000002,M000003,M000005 while expecting accepted citations ending M000005,M000002. This reuses a proposal premise as an additional row, violates the required supplied-row subsequence order, and silently repairs/reorders the model output. operation_contract.json and memory_transport_contract.json instead require additional rows to exclude premises, require support_row_ids to be a supplied-order subsequence, and classify violations illegal with no repair. Since the schema file and contracts are jointly normative, the current vector is a PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Issue newly hash-bound bytes that either make the vector a named rejection case or replace supplied additional_rows with M000005,M000002, replace support_row_ids with M000005,M000002, and retain accepted citations M000004,M000001,M000003,M000005,M000002. Add this exact vector to P1CB03 and require the illegal existing bytes to fail rather than normalize.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The seed-generic DEV projection repair does not close one witnessed-row identity domain across the projector, operation contract, and schemas.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: public_projection_contract.json and public_event.schema.json define the registered maximum as index 48; the independently reproduced seed-1 lives require E/M000046-M000048. operation_contract.json model_local_identity nevertheless says public and witnessed aliases end at 45. Conversely, memory_row.schema.json and dream_state.schema.json use ^M0000[0-9]{2}$, admitting witnessed M000049 through M000099 although no registered public event can produce them. This is not merely a hash relation that JSON Schema cannot express: the closed lexical identity domain itself differs across normative resources.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Explicitly scope held-out recurrence prose without redefining the global identity domain, and tighten every witnessed-row schema to M000000-M000048. Add P1CB01/P1CB03/P1CB05 positives for M000046-M000048 and negatives for M000049-M000099, while preserving all verified seed-5 bytes.
